requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Writing chemical equations and balancing chemical equations using law of conservation of mass.
requirements.review_note: Core skill in chemical equation balancing.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Quantitative and qualitative implications of a balanced chemical equation.
requirements.review_note: Understanding conservation principles in chemical transformations.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Types of Chemical Reactions: Combination and Decomposition
requirements.official_requirement: Combination reactions and thermal, electrolytic, and photolytic decomposition reactions.
requirements.review_note: Covers reaction classification and observational identification.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Types of Chemical Reactions: Displacement and Double Displacement
requirements.official_requirement: Displacement and double displacement reactions with aqueous salt solutions.
requirements.review_note: Includes reactivity series application in single displacement.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Types of Chemical Reactions: Precipitation and Neutralization
requirements.official_requirement: Precipitation reactions producing insoluble salts and acid-base neutralization reactions.
requirements.review_note: Linked directly with aqueous ionic interactions.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Types of Chemical Reactions: Oxidation and Reduction
requirements.official_requirement: Oxidation and reduction processes in terms of oxygen/hydrogen gain or loss.
requirements.review_note: Identification of oxidizing and reducing agents in basic redox reactions.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Definitions of acids and bases based on furnishing hydrogen ions (H+) and hydroxide ions (OH-).
requirements.review_note: Arrhenius concept of acids and bases.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Chemical Properties of Acids and Bases
requirements.official_requirement: General chemical properties, indicators, and reactions with metals, metal carbonates, and hydrogen carbonates.
requirements.review_note: Includes lab indicators (litmus, phenolphthalein, methyl orange) and gas evolution tests.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Concept of pH scale (definition relating to logarithm not required) and universal indicator.
requirements.review_note: Mathematical logarithmic formula -log[H+] is strictly non-assessable.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Importance of pH in everyday life, digestive system, tooth decay, soil testing, and self-defense by animals/plants.
requirements.review_note: Contextual real-world application of acidity and alkalinity.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Preparation and Uses of Important Chemical Compounds
requirements.official_requirement: Preparation, properties, and uses of Sodium Hydroxide, Bleaching Powder, Baking Soda, Washing Soda, and Plaster of Paris.
requirements.review_note: Includes chlor-alkali process and water of crystallization concept.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Physical and chemical properties of metals and non-metals, including reactions with water, air, and acids.
requirements.review_note: Comparative chemical behavior of metallic and non-metallic elements.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Reactivity series of metals and its application in displacement predictions.
requirements.review_note: Relative reactivity ordering of metals.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Formation and Properties of Ionic Compounds
requirements.official_requirement: Formation and properties of ionic compounds through electron transfer.
requirements.review_note: Electron dot structures, melting points, solubility, and electrical conductivity.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Covalent bonding in carbon compounds, electron dot structures of simple molecules.
requirements.review_note: Sharing of electrons in single, double, and triple covalent bonds.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_topic: Versatile Nature of Carbon and Hydrocarbons
requirements.official_requirement: Versatile nature of carbon (catenation and tetravalency) and distinction between saturated and unsaturated hydrocarbons.
requirements.review_note: Structural chains, branches, rings, alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Homologous series, structural characteristics, molecular formula trends, and physical property gradients.
requirements.review_note: CH2 gradation in successive members of organic series.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Nomenclature of carbon compounds containing functional groups (halogens, alcohol, ketones, aldehydes, alkanes, and alkynes).
requirements.review_note: IUPAC naming conventions for simple carbon compounds.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Chemical properties of carbon compounds: combustion, oxidation, addition, and substitution reactions.
requirements.review_note: Reactivity of saturated vs unsaturated hydrocarbons.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Properties and uses of Ethanol and Ethanoic Acid, esterification, and saponification reactions.
requirements.review_note: Reactions with sodium, carbonates, and alcohol-acid condensation.

requirements.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
requirements.official_requirement: Structure, cleansing action of soaps and synthetic detergents, and micelle formation mechanism.
requirements.review_note: Hydrophobic and hydrophilic end mechanisms in hard vs soft water.

requirements.official_requirement: Basic concept of living beings, molecular movement, and necessity of maintenance processes.
requirements.review_note: Foundational introduction to life-maintaining biological systems.

requirements.official_requirement: Autotrophic nutrition (photosynthesis mechanism, stomata function) and heterotrophic nutrition in plants and animals (human alimentary canal).
requirements.review_note: Includes digestive enzymes, nutrient absorption, and lab starch/CO2 experiments.

requirements.official_requirement: Aerobic and anaerobic respiration, breakdown pathways of glucose, and human respiratory system.
requirements.review_note: Includes ATP production, gas exchange in alveoli and plant tissue.

requirements.official_requirement: Transportation in human beings (heart structure, blood circulation, double circulation) and plants (xylem, phloem transport).
requirements.review_note: Covers transpiration pull, translocation, blood vessels, and lymph.

requirements.official_requirement: Excretion in human beings (nephron structure, urine formation) and waste disposal mechanisms in plants.
requirements.review_note: Kidney filtration mechanisms and plant metabolic byproduct removal.

requirements.official_chapter: Control and Coordination in Animals and Plants
requirements.official_requirement: Tropic movements in plants: phototropism, geotropism, hydrotropism, chemotropism, and thigmotropism.
requirements.review_note: Directional growth responses in plants.

requirements.official_chapter: Control and Coordination in Animals and Plants
requirements.official_requirement: Introduction to plant hormones (auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid) and their functional roles.
requirements.review_note: Growth promotion vs inhibition signaling in flora.

requirements.official_chapter: Control and Coordination in Animals and Plants
requirements.official_requirement: Control and coordination in animals: nervous system, neuron structure, central and peripheral nervous systems, voluntary/involuntary actions, and reflex arc.
requirements.review_note: Includes brain structure functions and synaptic impulse transmission.

requirements.official_chapter: Control and Coordination in Animals and Plants
requirements.official_requirement: Chemical coordination: endocrine glands, animal hormones (thyroxin, insulin, adrenaline, growth hormone, testosterone, estrogen), and feedback mechanisms.
requirements.review_note: Hormone function, gland locations, and regulatory feedback loops.

requirements.official_requirement: Modes of asexual reproduction (fission, fragmentation, regeneration, budding, vegetative propagation, spore formation) and sexual reproduction in flowering plants and animals.
requirements.review_note: Includes flower anatomy, pollination, fertilization, and human reproductive systems.

requirements.official_requirement: Reproductive health: need for family planning, barrier, chemical, surgical, and IUCD contraceptive methods.
requirements.review_note: Mechanisms and significance of birth control.

requirements.official_topic: Sexually Transmitted Diseases and Women Health
requirements.official_requirement: Prevention of Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STDs including HIV/AIDS) and considerations of child bearing and women's health.
requirements.review_note: Public health awareness and safe reproductive practices.

requirements.official_requirement: Heredity concepts, variation generation during reproduction, and inheritance of traits.
requirements.review_note: Transmission of inherited genetic characteristics across generations.

requirements.official_requirement: Mendel's contributions, laws for inheritance of traits, monohybrid and dihybrid cross ratios.
requirements.review_note: Dominant vs recessive alleles, 3:1 phenotypic and 9:3:3:1 ratios.

requirements.official_requirement: Brief introduction to sex determination mechanisms in human beings (XX and XY chromosomes).
requirements.review_note: Genetic basis of offspring sex determination.

requirements.official_requirement: Reflection of light by curved surfaces, spherical mirrors, ray diagrams, principal focus, mirror formula, and magnification.
requirements.review_note: Concave/convex mirror numericals, sign conventions, and image characterization.

requirements.official_requirement: Refraction laws, refractive index, refraction through glass slab, spherical lenses, lens formula, magnification, and power of a lens.
requirements.review_note: Includes Snell's Law, power in dioptres (P=1/f), and combination lens computations.

requirements.official_chapter: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
requirements.official_topic: Human Eye Lens Function and Vision Defects
requirements.official_requirement: Functioning of lens in human eye, accommodation, defects of vision (myopia, hypermetropia, presbyopia) and correction using lenses.
requirements.review_note: Ray diagrams for defective eye and focal power correction calculations.

requirements.official_chapter: The Human Eye and the Colourful World
requirements.official_topic: Prism Refraction, Dispersion, and Atmospheric Phenomena
requirements.official_requirement: Refraction through a glass prism, dispersion of white light, rainbow formation, atmospheric refraction, and scattering of light.
requirements.review_note: Explains twinkling stars, blue sky color, and sun appearance at sunrise/sunset.

requirements.official_topic: Electric Current, Ohm's Law, and Resistance
requirements.official_requirement: Electric current, potential difference, Ohm's law, resistance, resistivity, factors affecting conductor resistance, series and parallel resistor combinations.
requirements.review_note: Equivalent resistance computation and V-I graph verification.

requirements.official_topic: Heating Effect of Current and Electric Power
requirements.official_requirement: Joule's law of heating, practical applications of heating effect, electric power, and mathematical interrelations between P, V, I, and R.
requirements.review_note: Commercial energy calculations (kWh), fuse rating, and appliance power dissipation.

requirements.official_topic: Magnetic Fields and Forces on Conductors
requirements.official_requirement: Magnetic field, field lines, field due to straight conductor, circular loop, solenoid, force on current-carrying conductor, and Fleming's Left-Hand Rule.
requirements.review_note: Right-hand thumb rule, magnetic field patterns, and motor effect principles.

requirements.official_topic: Direct Current, Alternating Current, and Domestic Circuits
requirements.official_requirement: Direct current (DC), alternating current (AC), frequency of AC, advantages of AC over DC, and domestic electric circuit wiring.
requirements.review_note: Covers live/neutral/earth wire functions, safety earthing, short-circuiting, and overloading.

requirements.official_requirement: Ecosystem components, food chains, food webs, trophic levels, 10 percent energy flow law, biological magnification, and ozone layer depletion.
requirements.review_note: Ecological balance and CFC impact on stratosphere.

requirements.official_requirement: Waste production, biodegradable and non-biodegradable substances, environmental impacts, and sustainable waste disposal practices.
requirements.review_note: Decomposition mechanisms and plastic pollution abatement.

exclusions.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
exclusions.official_chapter: Legacy Chapter 5: Periodic Classification of Elements
exclusions.excluded_topic: Entire chapter on Periodic Classification of Elements (Dobereiner Triads, Newlands Octaves, Mendeleev Table, Modern Periodic Table)
exclusions.review_note: Fully removed from NCERT Class 10 textbook and CBSE 2026-27 examination syllabus.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Must be deactivated from active diagnostic baselines and board assessment banks.

exclusions.official_unit: Unit I: Chemical Substances - Nature and Behaviour
exclusions.excluded_topic: Basic Metallurgical Processes, Corrosion and its Prevention
exclusions.review_note: Omitted from official CBSE 2026-27 theory syllabus details.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Exclude metallurgy extraction processes and detailed corrosion mechanisms from Grade 10 summative evaluation.

exclusions.excluded_topic: Evolution, Speciation, Origin of Life, and Evolutionary Relationships
exclusions.review_note: Chapter retitled to 'Heredity' in current NCERT textbook reprints.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Retain Heredity only. Deactivate Darwinism, speciation, and fossils from active diagnostic sets.

exclusions.excluded_topic: Electric Motor, Electromagnetic Induction, Fleming's Right-Hand Rule, Electric Generator
exclusions.review_note: Explicitly deleted from rationalised NCERT textbook and CBSE 2026-27 exam syllabus.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Exclude motor and generator construction/working questions from active Class 10 assessment pools.

exclusions.excluded_topic: Entire chapter on Sources of Energy (Conventional and Non-conventional energy sources)
exclusions.review_note: Rationalised out of Class 10 Science textbook.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Completely purge/archive active questions for Grade 10 board tests.

exclusions.official_chapter: Legacy Chapter 16: Management of Natural Resources
exclusions.excluded_topic: Entire chapter on Sustainable Management of Natural Resources (Dams, Forests, Wildlife, Water Harvesting)
exclusions.review_note: Excluded from annual written board examination.
exclusions.candidate_effect_statement: Restrict to portfolio/project module. Do not include in external Board Examination diagnostics.

ambiguities.topic: Status of Periodic Classification of Elements in NEP/NCF transition context
ambiguities.cbse_evidence: CBSE Secondary Curriculum 2026-27 (Science_SecP1_2026-27.pdf) completely omits Chapter 5 Periodic Classification from Unit I.
ambiguities.ncert_evidence: NCERT Rationalised Textbook for Class 10 contains 13 chapters, excluding Periodic Classification.
ambiguities.rationalised_content_evidence: Rationalised Content Document (Class10.pdf) marks Chapter 5 as dropped content.
ambiguities.unresolved_issue: Higher-grade chemistry prerequisites (Class 11) rely on periodic trends; human SME must decide whether to retain as optional PREREQUISITE in EduOS.

ambiguities.topic: Metallurgical Processes and Corrosion inclusion in Metals and Non-metals
ambiguities.cbse_evidence: CBSE 2026-27 syllabus text stops at 'Formation and properties of ionic compounds'. Metallurgy is omitted.
ambiguities.ncert_evidence: Older NCERT editions contained extensive sections on metallurgy and corrosion; rationalised edition reduced this scope.
ambiguities.rationalised_content_evidence: NCERT rationalisation notes list reductions in Chapter 3.
ambiguities.unresolved_issue: None. Board examination scope strictly excludes metallurgy calculations and extraction steps.
